ctx.x: You see, Heflin might...that might have been a out-of-town band that he just had that cut and put it on there.

I wondered. Because it lists the names of people who were appearing on this particular show but I don't recognize the people in that band. For this particular show, Woody Herman was master of ceremonies, and then they had the Valdez Orchestra. , I don't know who that is. The Blenders, which is some group that had Jimmie Grissom in it; T-Bone Walker; The Honey Drippers, which would be Joe Liggins; Slim Gaillard; Johnny Otis and his Orchestra; Toni Harper; and then Woody Herman and Sarah Vaughan, and the 3 Blazers.…
